facts: Publisher work reformats existing upstream binaries into OCI image manifests without re-bundling their content. [L6]
ocx_mirror is a pipeline driven by a YAML spec that runs download, bundle and push through the ocx_lib publisher API. [L10]
ocx_mirror batches cascade resolution across platforms in one invocation and caps new releases per run with new_per_run. [L12]
Cross-release layer reuse is a hand-publisher technique; ocx_mirror always uploads each platform archive afresh. [L12]
The minimal spec wraps one GitHub release project, mapping per-platform asset patterns and stripping one archive component. [L14]
cascade defaults to true and should be set false only for repositories that must not advance rolling tags. [L42]
The CMake example adds a multi-platform asset matrix, version-range filtering and per-platform metadata overrides. [L44]
For each platform, the union of asset regexes must resolve to exactly one asset filename per release. [L56]
The version range keeps mirroring to releases from 3.31.0 onward and caps the run at ten new releases. [L79]
The github_release source reads the release feed and pushes through the same publisher API as ocx package create and push. [L90]
Ambiguous matches abort the run; two regexes matching the same filename are fine, while different filenames are an error. [L100]
GitHub release tarballs wrap content in a version-named directory, but OCX bundles need a flat surface at the root. [L104]
The example uses --extract with --strip-components 1 to bundle a downloaded release asset without unpacking it by hand. [L106]
--extract runs the metadata sidecar, binaries scan and libc check against the extracted tree, as if it were a directory. [L117]
--strip-components runs once at authoring time, unlike the metadata strip_components field, which applies at every install. [L117]
Homebrew formulae are Ruby programs with no general import path, so their URLs and checksums are migrated by hand. [L121]
Binary bottles unpack as formula, version, bin, so strip_components 2 fits and the PATH entry must be public. [L123]
Source-built formulae do not migrate cleanly without rebuilding, because OCX is a binary package manager. [L123]
description push stores README, logo, title and keywords under the __ocx.desc tag, and description pull reads them back. [L127]
The mirror pipeline does not push descriptions, so re-run description push whenever the README or logo changes. [L143]
